claim: A back edge guarded on `X @this` where the loop body binds or controls a unit AFTER reading X can never exit: the claim makes the guard true forever.
why: UnitControlI.checkLogicAI sets `la.controller = this processor` on every `ubind`/`ucontrol`, so `@controller == @this` holds from the claim onward. Read-then-claim is the correct order (that is the anti-steal idiom) and must not be reported.
